COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
SA No.93 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate, 
assisted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate, for 
the appellant. 
Learned counsel for the 
appellant/plaintiff, submits that the sale deed,
which was executed by the Baljindra Singh on 
16.09.2008, in favour of the defendant no.5, is a 
subject matter of the challenge in a different 
suit. He is directed to place on record the copy 
of the plaint of the said suit, and the particulars 
as to what is the stage of the proceedings of the 
suit, where the sale deed has been put to 
challenge.
He may place the aforesaid fact on record 
within a period of three weeks from today.
List thereafter.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 07.07.2022
